label: copy-phase input r (early recall positions)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always when the fed-back input token is r (88% of activation mass; i takes most of the remainder, about 11%). Concentrated at recall_idx 2-3 (86% of mass) and in longer sequences (rate rises with L; never for L<=4). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases and never on the first occurrence of a token. It is extremely selective, though: it fires on only about 3% of copy-phase r inputs at recall_idx 2-4, and no simple context (L, prev_tok, next_out, in_count) brought precision above about 0.2 without large recall losses. So the description covers the activation mass but does not say which r steps fire. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.02 above threshold). The largest activations are r at recall_idx 2-3 with L>=7, but I did not find a clean magnitude modulator.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+4.41), phase=2 & in_tok=r (+3.83), in_tok=r (+2.72), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+2.47), orig4=y (+2.26), orig5=y (+1.91). Lower it: orig3=a (-1.77), recall_idx=5 (-1.73), next_out=k (-1.68), prev_tok=l (-1.68).
